body: P2 (high, reproduced as M33), fixed in f4eed1cc. The hostile-Git red regexes required only the root and the hook, so a no-op content check passed every test. The red reasons are now required in full (root, content and hook for the environment attack; root and content for the local worktree; the hook for the local include); validation section 7 shows M33 red in the aggregate and the individual selector.

P2 (high, reproduced as M04 and M05), fixed in f4eed1cc. Only the GIT_DIR redirect was asserted, so inert config, ceiling or alternates values passed. test_hostile_git_probe now shows each of the six GIT_* names, alone, changing what git does in the legitimate repository (the git dir, the work tree, the global and system config, discovery from a subdirectory, and an attacker object made readable); M04 and M05 are red (section 7).

P2 (high, reproduced as M14, M15, M16), fixed in f4eed1cc. A spy that wraps subprocess.run (still executing) now asserts the exact parent argv and env={} in the trusted-parent case, so dropping -i, the bash flags or the empty environment fails the aggregate and the individual selector (section 7).

P2 (high, reproduced), fixed in f4eed1cc. The single-served input FIFO hung a second read or a write-open. The worker-root probe no longer uses a FIFO or a thread: the input is a regular file whose zeroed access time shows a read (measured live on a scratch file at construction; the probe refuses a filesystem where a read leaves it at 0), so repeated reads and appends cannot hang.

P2 (high, reproduced), fixed in f4eed1cc. An unlinked input broke cleanup and leaked the directory and thread; an atomic replace went undetected. With no FIFO or thread, the fixture context manager always removes its directory, and test_worker_root_probe covers a shell append, a shell replacement (a changed inode) and an unlink (reported as removed).
P3 (medium), fixed in f4eed1cc by the same redesign: the input is a regular file, so a consumer that rejects non-regular files cannot pass the input subcase for the wrong reason.

P3 (high, reproduced as M18), fixed in f4eed1cc. Each refusal subtest now asserts its message (not an absolute path, outside, not a regular file), so removing the relative-path refusal is red (section 7).

P3 (medium, reproduced as M25), fixed in f4eed1cc. test_trusted_parent_probe first asserts the real repository_root() equals the checkout under hostile GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE, before any fixture substitutes it; M25 is red (section 7).

P3 (high), addressed in the evidence. The validation printer elides the inherited variable names to a count and the inherited PATH to a placeholder before pasting, so no seat environment or home path reaches the record.

P3 notes, declared without a code change. (a) dscl . -read fails inside the worker sandbox (exit 70), so an unmocked run_under_trusted_parent raises on macOS under that sandbox; consumer tests substitute _directory_service, and the report states it. (b) Ruff rules outside the repository configuration (E501 on the shim template line, E731 on one test lambda) are not enabled in ruff.toml; ruff check with the repository configuration is clean.

One round by a fresh read-only subagent on origin/main..4729b83c, given the commit range and the task file. Verdict incorrect: five P2 and five P3, from a 36-mutant run (eight survivors). The P2 and the P3 that had a code effect were fixed in one worker-side round (f4eed1cc); the eight survivors and four further no-op assertions are red at f4eed1cc (validation section 7); both interpreters pass (section 5). Local process evidence, not the task-level audit.
